outputs.explanation: Panel a is a schematic illustrating image cropping/rotation/resizing, accompanied by example micrographs. There is no plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel b is a schematic/micrograph example showing how to space separate images in a figure; no quantitative plot or averaged data is shown.
Panel c shows a schematic and micrographs illustrating how to present zoomed insets with their origin; no data plot is present.
Panel d shows a brightness/contrast slider schematic with example grayscale micrographs at different settings; it is not a plot of averaged data.
Panel e illustrates channel annotation visibility with schematic color circles and example micrographs/staining image; no averaged-data plot is present.
Panel f is a schematic comparing color-merged vs. grayscale channel display, with example micrographs; it contains no quantitative plot.
Panel g shows micrographs with calibration/intensity scale bars as legends, not a plot of averaged data requiring individual data points.
